scene1Childhood.memory: My mother taught me to knead bread in our small kitchen. I got flour on my nose.

scene2TeenFreedom.memory: I took the bus to my first bakery job, carrying the apron she had sewn.

scene3LeapOfFaith.memory: When the bakery closed, I started baking for neighbors at home.

scene4Romance.memory: Your grandpa carried the heavy bread baskets. He always sneaked one warm roll.

scene5LegacyFinale.memory: Leo, I want you to remember our Sunday bread. Making something for someone is a way to say I love you.
